column1: # Redistribution-notice manifest for the bundled OCR runtime.
# bundle-tesseract.ps1 ships tesseract.exe plus every DLL beside it (51 today),
# enumerated rather than hand-listed so the copy set cannot rot when upstream
# changes its dependencies. The upstream installer supplies notices for two of
# those 52 binaries; this manifest accounts for the rest, and the build REFUSES
# if a shipped binary has no row here or its notice is missing.
# COLUMNS: file <TAB> component <TAB> spdx <TAB> notice <TAB> source
#   file      exact filename as shipped in resources/tesseract/
#   component upstream project (several files legitimately share one)
#   spdx      SPDX expression. "OR" = we may rely on any listed licence;
#             the notice file carries the text(s) that choice requires.
#   source    upstream the notice text came from
#  - A dependency is never removed to simplify this file. Every component gets
#  - Copyleft components are ordinary rows. libjbig (GPL-2.0) and the GCC
#    runtime (GPL-3.0 WITH the Runtime Library Exception) are listed exactly
#    like the permissive ones: this project is MIT open source with a public
#    repository, so the source column answers "where is the source".
#  - Keep sorted by filename so a diff against a fresh `Get-ChildItem` reads
